# GE Vernova (GEV) Q1 2025 earnings summary
## Q1 2025 earnings summary
### Executive summary
- Achieved strong Q1 2025 results with 11% revenue growth (15% organically), significant margin expansion, and net income of $264M, up $370M year-over-year.
- Orders rose 8% to $10.2B, led by services and Power equipment; backlog reached $123.4B, up 6% year-over-year.
- Free cash flow improved by $1.6B year-over-year to $1.0B, supporting investment and shareholder returns.
- Returned $1.5B to shareholders YTD via share repurchases and inaugural dividend; ended Q1 with $8.1B cash.
- Reaffirmed 2025 guidance despite $300–$400M in expected tariff/inflation impacts, with mitigation actions underway.
### Financial highlights
- Q1 revenue grew 15% organically to $8.2B; adjusted EBITDA rose to $460M, margin expanded 170 bps to 5.7%.
- Power segment: orders up 28% to $6.2B, revenue up 16% to $4.4B, EBITDA margin 11.5%.
### Outlook and guidance
- 2025 revenue expected at $36–$37B, high-single-digit adjusted EBITDA margin, and free cash flow of $2.0–$2.5B.
- Power: mid-single-digit organic revenue growth, 13–14% EBITDA margin.
- Wind: organic revenue down mid-single digits, $200–$400M segment EBITDA losses.

  Revenue rose 11% from a year earlier to $8.03 billion, also topping estimates of $7.55 billion.
